Ordinary Council Meetings

Agendas and Minutes for the current year are listed below.  To view minutes from previous years, please click here.

Please click here to view Ordinary Council Meeting Dates for the current year.

Please click here to listen to the Audio of the Ordinary Council Meetings. 

Shire of Shark Bay Council meetings are held on the last Wednesday of every month unless otherwise advised. 

There are no meetings held in January.

Meetings are held in the Council Chambers located at the Shark Bay Recreation Centre, Francis Road, Denham.

If you need any further assistance with agendas and minutes, please contact the Council's Executive Assistant.

Telephone: (08) 9948 1218

Email: admin@sharkbay.wa.gov.au
